newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Prudential cautious on Kodak.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Prudential cautious on Kodak.

text.p: Prudential Securities analyst Alex Henderson said he remains cautious in his outlook on Eastman Kodak Co and is unsure whether the company will meet analysts' estimates with its second quarter results.
-- "It's a coin toss," Henderson said. "The market share data looks awful and the June numbers looked weak."
-- Henderson, who has been cautious on Kodak for some time, also said even if Kodak managed to meet estimates, he still would be concerned about the company's outlook.

"I think you could make a case that thay could somehow hit the number, because their prices were up in the quarter," he said. "But even if they do, it wouldn't mean they've addressed some fundamental issues and we still think there's a lot of risk in the stock.

Those issues, he said, include price reductions by Fuji Photo Film Co Ltd. Kodak's loss of market share, he said, stemmed from the company's decision not to lower prices in response and the market share erosion that followed is a critical problem for the company, he said.
Until Kodak finds a way to stem the erosion and recapture market share, Henderson said, "it's appropriate that investors remain cautious."
Kodak shares opened Friday down one at 77 on the NYSE.
